finding.title: OS/kernel unresolved — no Windows symbol table match
finding.description: Volatility3 2.28.0 completed scanning the raw 512 MiB image but could not validate kernel.layer_name / kernel.symbol_table_name across pslist/netscan/malfind/svcscan. The unattributed 2014 capture has no profile-matchable Windows kernel; pslist returns 11 pid-0 placeholder rows, not real processes.
